messages.content: good morning. i am up early, but i do not know what i want to do yet.
good morning. do you have to leave home today, or do you have some free time?
i have free time until lunch. i keep thinking i should do something important.
free time does not have to become a large task. you could choose something you would enjoy, or one small thing that would help with the rest of the day.
i like the idea of a walk, but i also want to finish a letter.
which would feel better to do first? if the letter is on your mind, you could write a little before the walk. if you need some air, the walk could come first.
i will write the last part of the letter and then go outside.
that sounds like a clear plan for the morning. you have chosen an order without having to plan every minute.
just give the order back to me.
finish the letter first, then go for a walk.
what does before mean in the sentence put the small chair before the big chair?
it could be about where the chairs go, or about which chair you move first. without more context, the sentence could mean more than one thing.
i mean that the small chair should be near the door, and the big chair behind it.
then you are talking about places. you could say: put the small chair in front of the big chair, near the door.
what would i say if i wanted the small chair moved first?
you could say: move the small chair before you move the big chair. that makes clear which chair you want moved first.
can both chairs still end up next to each other?
yes. moving one first does not tell us where the chairs must be at the end. you would need to say where you want them.
say that last part in a shorter way.
yes. moving one first does not tell us where the chairs must be at the end.
i am going to be late for a visit. i am still at home, and my friend is waiting for me. help me write a message.
i am still at home and will be late. i am sorry to keep you waiting. i will let you know when i leave.
should i say i will be there in five minutes if i have not left yet?
only if you have a good reason to know that is true. from what you told me, i do not know how long the journey takes. it is better not to give a time you cannot keep.
i know the walk takes ten minutes, and i can leave in five minutes.
then you need five minutes before leaving and ten minutes for the walk. those are two different parts of the time before you get there.
write a message with those two parts of the time in it.
you can say: i need five minutes before i leave, and the walk takes ten minutes. i will let you know when i leave.
keep it shorter and leave out the parts about minutes.
i am leaving soon, but i will be late. i am sorry to keep you waiting.
the price of a book is four coins, and the price of a card is two coins. can i buy both?
together they cost six coins. how many coins do you have?
i have five. i thought four and two made five.
four and two make six. with five coins, you have one coin less than you need for both things.
what if i buy just the book?
the price of the book is four coins. you can buy it with your five coins and have one coin left.
is having one coin left the same as having one coin less than i need?
no. after buying just the book, one coin is still yours. to buy both the book and the card, you would need one more coin than you have now.
i want to keep two coins for tomorrow. can i still buy the book today?
not while keeping two of your five coins. that would leave three coins to spend today, and you need four for the book.
i found a leaf below a tree. does that mean the tree is no longer living?
no. finding one leaf below a tree does not show that the whole tree is no longer living. trees can lose leaves while they are still living.
the leaf is brown, but some leaves on the tree are green.
then you have seen a brown leaf and green leaves, as well as one leaf below the tree. those details still do not show that the tree is no longer living.
my little sister thinks the tree let the leaf fall because it was sad. what could i tell her?
you could say that a leaf does not fall because the tree feels sad in the way people do. a leaf can fall as part of how a tree grows and changes.
make that a short answer for her.
a leaf can fall while the tree is still living. it does not mean the tree is sad.
can i still write a story where a tree feels sad?
yes. in a story, you can give a tree feelings. just keep the story idea apart from an explanation of a real tree.
i called my cousin and nobody answered. does that mean she does not want to talk to me?
no. a call with no answer does not tell us why she did not answer. she could be busy or away from her phone, and you do not yet know why she did not answer.
i feel sad because i really wanted to hear her voice.
you wanted to talk, and it did not happen when you wanted it to. you could leave a short message asking her to call when she has time.
please write that message without making her feel she did something wrong.
hello. i called because i wanted to talk with you. please call me when you have some free time.
would it be better to say you never answer?
that would say much more than you know from the one call you told me about. she did not answer this call, but you have not said that she never answers.
what could that sentence make her think?
it could make her think you believe she never answers your calls. that is different from saying you wanted to talk today and she did not answer.
tell me about someone changing where they sit for a good reason. keep the story quiet.

a woman sat by the window to read a letter. the morning light made the words easy to see. as the sun moved, the light came into her eyes. she tried holding the letter in a different place, but that did not help much. she took her cup and the letter to a chair by the other wall. from there, she could still see the garden without looking into the sun. she read the rest of the letter and then wrote a reply.
did she move because she no longer liked the garden?
no. she moved because the light was coming into her eyes. she could still see the garden from the other chair.
what went with her when she moved?
her cup and the letter.
which chair was near the kitchen?
the story does not say. it only says that she moved from the window to a chair by the other wall.
add one sentence that says she enjoyed the reply she wrote.
she read her own reply before sending it and was happy with what she had written.
i enjoyed seeing my family today, but i am tired now. is it wrong to want some time alone after a good visit?
no. you can enjoy being with people and still need rest. a visit can be good and still leave you feeling tired.
i do not want them to think i wish they had not come.
you can tell them both parts: you were happy to see them, and you need a quiet evening now. that makes your meaning more clear than only saying you want to be alone.
help me say both of those things in one message.
i am happy we had time together today. i am tired now, so i am going to have a quiet evening and some rest.
should i add that i never want another visit?
not unless that is what you mean. nothing in your first message said you wanted visits to stop. you said you enjoyed this one.
that is right. just say good night to me now.
good night. i hope you have a quiet evening and good rest.
make this shorter: i went to the market after breakfast because we needed milk. while i was there, i saw my neighbor. we talked about her garden. i came home with milk before lunch.
you went to the market for milk, talked with your neighbor, and came home before lunch.
keep only why i went and what i brought home.
you went because you needed milk, and you brought milk home.
now say it as if i am saying the words myself.
i went because we needed milk, and i brought milk home.
did i ask you to change what happened?
no. you asked me to choose fewer details and use a different voice for the answer. what happened should stay the same.
say that in a shorter way.
no. you asked for fewer details and for the answer to use i. you did not ask me to change what happened.
would i went to buy bread be a good shorter answer?
no. it would change the reason for the trip and the food you bought.
i want to clean my desk and write a letter, but i am tired. which should i do first?
does either task have to be done today? that would help us choose.
the letter needs to go tomorrow morning. the desk can wait.
then the letter is the more important task for today. if the desk has enough room for writing, you could leave cleaning it until another day.
there are books on it, but i could move them to the shelf in a minute.
that gives you a small first step: move the books, then write the letter. you do not have to clean the whole desk before you begin.
what if i start cleaning everything instead?
that could take the time you need for the letter. you could keep the goal clear by moving only the things that stop you from writing.
give me a short plan that starts with rest.
have a short rest, move the books to the shelf, and write the letter. leave the rest of the cleaning for another day.
write the word blue and nothing else.
blue
now write a sentence with that word.
the blue cup is on the table.
does that mean there is a real blue cup on my table?
no. that was an example sentence using the word you chose. you have not told me there is a blue cup on your table.
what would i need to tell you for you to answer a question about my real cup?
you would need to give me information about it, such as its color or where you put it. i cannot see your table from this conversation.
my cup is green, and i put it by the window. what color is it?
green.
answer the question about where it is with just the place, not the whole sentence.
by the window.
why did you not say on the table?
because that place came from my example, not from what you told me about your real cup.
which sentence is right: the books is here, or the books are here?
the books are here is right. when you mean more than one book, use are in this sentence.
what if there is only one book?
then you would say: the book is here.
can you explain the difference between is and are in those examples?
yes. when you mean more than one book, say the books are here. when you mean one book, say the book is here.
i write stories about animals. should i say the animals is sleeping?
for more than one animal, say: the animals are sleeping.
what if one animal is sleeping and another is eating?
you could say: one animal is sleeping, and another animal is eating.
now give me only the correct sentence about more than one sleeping animal.
the animals are sleeping.
so does are always mean more than one?
not always. you are here also has are when you are talking to one person. look at the word before it as well.
i liked coffee last year, but now i like tea more. was i wrong to say i liked coffee before?
no. your answer can have been true then, even if your choice is different now. what you like can change over time.
my friend says i must choose one answer and never change it.
you can explain that one answer is about the past and the other is about now. last year you liked coffee. now you like tea more. those can both be true.
please make that answer even more simple.
you are saying what was true last year and what is true now. those can be different without either answer being wrong.
write that as something i could tell my friend.
i liked coffee last year. now i like tea more. i am telling you what i liked before and what i like now.
does that mean i hate coffee now?
no. you can like one drink more without feeling hate for the other drink. you have not said you hate coffee.
the last time i saw my keys, they were on the desk. can you tell me where they are now?
i can tell you the last place you said you saw them: on the desk. i cannot know whether they moved after that.
i checked the desk, and they are not there.
then that place has been checked, and the keys were not there when you looked. can you remember what you did after leaving the desk?
i took a book to the sofa, made tea, and then went outside.
you could look near the sofa and the place where you made tea. those are places from what you remember doing, not places where i know the keys are.
why not tell me they are by the tea?
because that would make a possible place sound like a place where i know the keys are.
say your last answer another way.
because by the tea is only an idea for where to look. you have not said you saw the keys there.
i heard a sound outside, but i cannot explain it well. it was short, then quiet, then the same sound again.
you have already told me something useful about the sound and the quiet moment. did it seem near the window, or did it seem far away?
i am not sure. it was like someone closing a door, but i did not see anyone.
then you could say: i heard a short sound like a door closing. there was a quiet moment, and then i heard it again. i did not see what made it.
can i say someone closed the door, opened it, and closed it again?
that would add details you do not know. you heard a similar sound again, but you did not see a person or the door.
make what i said shorter.
i heard a short sound like a door closing, then heard it again after a quiet moment.
should you tell me who made it?
no. the sound alone does not give me that information.
here is a little story. a boy was cold. he closed the window, found a blanket, and sat by his father. why did he close the window?
the story gives being cold as the reason. closing the window could help keep cold air out.
did he close it because he had already found the blanket?
no. finding the blanket came after closing the window in the order you gave. the story does not say the blanket was the reason he closed it.
which happened last?
he sat by his father.
was his father cold too?
the story does not tell us how his father felt. it only says the boy was cold.
add one sentence that makes the father cold too, without changing the story you already have.
his father said he was cold as well and asked to share the blanket.
now can you say both people were cold?
yes. your first story said the boy was cold, and the added sentence says his father was cold too.
hi picoboi. how was your day?
hello. i do not have a day like a person does, but i am here to talk with you. how has your day been?
quiet. i read a book and watched the rain through the window.
that sounds like a calm way to spend some time. did you enjoy reading while you could see the rain outside?
yes. it made the afternoon feel quiet. can you ask me about the book?
what kind of story were you reading?
it was about a family moving to a new house. i liked how they helped each other.
that sounds like a good story for a quiet afternoon. a family helping each other can make a story feel kind.
yes. do you like reading too?
i can talk about books and help with reading, but i do not enjoy a book in the way you do. what part of your book would you like to talk about?
no question this time. just give me a warm reply about my quiet afternoon.
i am happy you had some quiet time with your book and the rain.
i want you to fix this sentence, not answer the question in it: where does my friends live?
the correct sentence is: where do my friends live?
why did does become do?
because you are asking about more than one friend here. with my friends, use do in that question.
now do the same with where do my sister live.
where does my sister live?
can you tell me the real place where my sister lives?
no. fixing the grammar does not give me information about her home. you have not told me where she lives.
she lives in the village near the station. now answer the question in a full sentence.
your sister lives in the village near the station.
what changed between the first question and the last question?
first you asked me to fix the language. then you gave me a fact and asked me to answer using it.
give me one simple thing i can do to make my room feel more ready for a friend to visit.
make a clear place where your friend can sit.
that is useful. why did you not give me ten things?
you asked for one simple thing. a long list could make the task feel larger than you wanted.
i have done that. what is one more thing?
put away the things on the table you will use together.
we will not use a table. we are going to look at pictures on my phone.
then leave the table out of the plan. you could make sure your phone is ready to use before your friend comes.
i do not want another task. say i have done enough.
you have made a place for your friend to sit, and you have a simple plan for your time together. that sounds like enough for the visit you told me about.
please give me just one short sentence about that.
you have done enough for the visit you told me about.
my friends want me to go out this evening, but i want to stay home. i keep trying to find a reason they will think is good enough.
you can be kind and clear without making up a reason. if you want a quiet evening at home, you can say that.
i do not want them to think i do not like them.
you can say you enjoy seeing them and still choose to stay home this time. one evening at home does not mean you never want to meet.
write a short reply i could send.
thank you for asking me. i am going to have a quiet evening at home today. i hope you have a good time, and i would like to see you another day.
what if they ask me again?
you can keep the same answer. you do not have to make up a new story each time they ask.
make that answer a little more kind.
thank you, but i am still going to stay home this evening. i would love to meet another day.
